verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents that admins can adjust card spend limits instantly and set custom limits ([jeeves-docs-20], [jeeves-docs-23]), and its MCP server can update card spending limits ([jeeves-docs-34]). That covers directly changing card-level limits, but nothing shows a self-service screen for requesting a limit increase or an approval workflow for such requests. Missing for 10: a documented limit-increase request flow (e.g. a company credit or transaction limit request to Jeeves), a description of the self-service UI screen, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
